currency: none (volumes in tonnes of fresh fruit bunches)

grains.RAW.SUPPLY_BASES: one row per supply base (mill-hub city x supplier type)
grains.RAW.SUPPLY_DAILY: one row per supply base per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.PLOT_REGISTRY: one row per supply base (plot geolocation snapshot)
grains.ML.CANOPY_RISK_SCORES: one row per supply base (latest day)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide FFB delivery FORECAST; geolocation mismatch ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.EUDR_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic traceability follow-up SOPs (one per supplier type and risk signal)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.EUDR_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.EUDR_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, supply base, risk-signal and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (supply bases, daily FFB deliveries, confirmed canopy-loss cases by supply base, canopy-loss risk, delivery events loaded) over an existing Snowflake data source
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: S3 PutObject of mill-gate FFB delivery batches -> S3 (deliveries/) -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_DELIVERIES
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_DELIVERY_ALERT logs new FLAG events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.canopy_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed canopy-loss case in next 7 days) per supply base, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
